url_detection.scope: Local URL heuristic only; VirusTotal is not queried.
url_detection.dataset_note: Synthetic, hand-labeled fixtures; not a real-world phishing corpus.

methodology.retrieval_relevance: A result is relevant only when its source filename and 1-based PDF page match a curated gold page.
methodology.retrieval_averaging: Macro average across benchmark questions; page-level binary relevance.
methodology.url_decision: High/Critical local risk is suspicious; Low/Medium is not suspicious.
methodology.answer_review: Claim support and citation correctness require manual review of generated answers; retrieval source-page alignment alone is not answer faithfulness.
